messages:
alice.chen: Quick sync — telemetry spike shows clients getting 503 for fallbacks and 429 for quota at different routing layers. Some SDKs treat 503 as retryable but 429 as terminal. This mismatch is causing weird client behavior and noisy retries. We should standardize client-facing mapping + console badging for 'degraded (fallback)' vs 'quota'. Thoughts?

marco: I saw those traces. Gateway emits 429 when token bucket hits, runtime emits 503 when capacity is exhausted and we fallback to a smaller model. SDKs that auto-retry 503 are making things worse during capacity pressure.

jess: Can we separate semantics: 'rate_limit' (client-level quota) vs 'capacity_pressure' (infrastructure shortage) vs 'validation'? Propose explicit headers + a small status mapping table in the API contract.

rory: From console side, we should surface two things per route: fallback_ratio and quota_throttles. Badge states: ok / degraded (fallbacks) / throttled (quota). That will make rollout UX clearer.

jess: Draft mapping (opinions):
```
# canonical client-facing mapping (proposal)
- rate_limit -> 429, include: Retry-After (seconds), X-Error-Bucket: quota
- capacity_pressure -> 503, include: Retry-After (seconds) or X-Fallback-Model (string), X-Error-Bucket: capacity
- validation_error -> 400 (client error), X-Error-Bucket: validation
- unhandled_model_failure -> 502, X-Error-Bucket: model_failure
- fallback_used_but_ok -> 200, include: X-Fallback-Used: true, X-Fallback-Model
```
Note: prefer 503 for infra pressure so SDKs can implement controlled retry with exponential backoff. 409 would be confusing here.

marco: +1 for explicit X-Error-Bucket. Also add X-Retry-Hint: "can_retry"/"no" and X-Recommended-Backoff (secs) to avoid guessing.

olivia: UX note — console copy should avoid alarm words. Use 'degraded (serving lower-capacity model)' instead of 'fallback' in badges for customer-facing dashboards. Internally we can keep 'fallback'.

jess: Telemetry keys we need: error_bucket, fallback_model, fallback_ratio (per-minute), retry_hints_used. These will feed alerts and the route dashboard.

marco: SDK changes (short): expose Error.code enum {THROTTLED, CAPACITY_PRESSURE, VALIDATION_ERROR, MODEL_FAILURE, FALLBACK_IN_USE} and Error.suggested_action {retryable, non_retryable, client_fix}. Also map Retry-After header if present.

alice.chen: Nice. Action items: 1) runtime/gateway add X-Error-Bucket + X-Fallback-Model + X-Retry-Hint (marco + eng-runtime) 2) SDK owners implement Error.code + respect X-Retry-Hint (jess + sdk) 3) console add badge and fallback_ratio metric (rory + olivia) 4) docs PR with canonical table and examples (alice)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: gateway: add-header X-Error-Bucket -> staged to canary (build 2026.3.12-canary).

olivia: I'll sketch microcopy for the badge and run it by legal for terminology. Will post a mock by EOD.

alice.chen: Great — let's sync tomorrow 11am to lock wording and finalize headers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
